Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7410); Aram (i.e. Ram), an Israelite:--Aram.
BiblicalUsage: Aram, also called Ram, is named in the genealogy of Jesus as the son of Hezron and the father of Aminadab, one link in the line from Judah through Perez to David. He appears only in the genealogy, carrying the promise forward one generation.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in the genealogy of Jesus is never filler, because the promise travelled through ordinary men who did nothing else worth recording.
